{{Quote|I sometimes can see the weak places in an opponent&mdash;shatterpoints where the unbreakable can be broken. They can occur in individuals&hellip;and in events.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref>}}
'''Shatterpoints''' were a complex [[The Force/Legends|Force]] phenomenon, perceivable through immense focus and concentration on the part of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]]. Shatterpoints were akin to fault lines, similar to different pathways of actions. Adept Force users were able to perceive these faults through the Force, and influence them.

==Description==
{{Quote|I can see every flaw. All I have to do is pour the Force into the cracks&hellip;|[[Cade Skywalker]], to the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Karness Muur]]|<ref name="leg31">[[Legacy (2006) 31|''Legacy'' (2006) 31]]</ref>}}
[[File:Shatterpoint_-_SWGTCG.jpg|left|thumb|A Force-user applies shatterpoint in lightsaber combat.]]
Shatterpoints were perceived like faults in a [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]]. At least to Windu, they were not seen exactly, but he used the term sight for he had no better way to describe the crack points of death and life.<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> On the other hand, another might see the fault lines as blazing mindfire to be seen and acted upon.<ref name="LegW6" /> In relation to events, a single "strike," or action, could cause events to transpire completely differently than they might otherwise have. Often, shatterpoints existed for only brief moments, as they could be affected by even the smallest actions.<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> Shatterpoints could also be discovered in the physiology of living beings. [[Cade Skywalker]] was able to perceive shatterpoints in [[Darth Talon]] and [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]], whom he had previously healed from [[Death/Legends|mortal injury]]. By focusing through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on where the healing had taken place, Skywalker was able to see where her old wounds were, and reopen them.<ref name="leg16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref> Windu in his own words stated "Put simply: when I look at you through the Force, I can see where you break."<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

When applied to physical items, shatterpoints worked much in the same manner. An individual would view an item through the Force, noting where it came together and also noting weak points in its composition. By allowing the Force to surge through them into the weak point, individuals could effectively "shatter" the object, causing it to break into multiple fragments. Because the Force granted supernatural ability to those who were adept in its use, materials thought to be near-indestructible were easily destroyed. Such was the case with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who effortlessly shattered a disc of pure [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] while practicing the technique under her uncle, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Invincible" />

==History==
[[File:Shannerpoint.jpg|thumb|[[Satele Shan]] shatters a blast door]]
[[Kreia]] could perceive shatterpoints which she described as "fractures." The status of the two phenomena as one and the same was implicit in Kreia's description of the fractures, which she said could be manipulated by finding the "critical point." Kreia's [[Kreia#Teachings|philosophy]] hinged in an important way around shatterpoints: ''prima facie'' benevolent actions might in fact end harmfully if one was unsure of the myriad repercussions that would follow.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Shortly prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] perceived [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to be a shatterpoint capable of ending the war. His attachments let his old friend live, however, and so Dooku was able to go on and initiate the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In only a short span of time, the shatterpoint that made Dooku the heart of the war disappeared.<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> Eventually Mace realized a number of shatterpoints connected with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], prior to Anakin's fall. Mace was also able to sense the Shatterpoint of Darth Sidious; his trust in Skywalker.<ref name="rotsn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']]</ref>

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] used this ability to destroy the beskar-forged [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protector]] [[Roegr]]. By tapping the breastplate lightly with the [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Caedus was able to completely shatter the armor. When Caedus was still Jacen Solo, he destroyed the blasters of several Centerpoint guards merely by exerting Force pressure in the weak points. Luke Skywalker revealed that he too could perceive shatterpoints, and taught this to Jaina Solo.<ref name="Invincible" /><ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

While in the [[Temple of the Sith]], a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Kol Skywalker]] approached his son and taught Cade how to use shatterpoint as a tool to defend himself. Cade used this technique to shatter the [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] case that contained his [[Kol Skywalker's lightsaber|father's lightsaber]] and sent the shattered fragments of transparisteel toward the Sith.<ref name="leg18">[[Legacy (2006) 18|''Legacy'' (2006) 18]]</ref> Cade later used it to destroy the ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as the [[Muur Talisman]] by pouring [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] into the relic's weak points.<ref name="leg31" /> He also tried to use shatterpoint to release [[Deliah Blue]] from a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bioform that had been attached to her back by [[Darth Maladi]] of the [[One Sith]], however, the biot resisted Cade's efforts, also causing excruciating pain to its host when exposed to the Force.<ref name="leg45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>
